directions.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Game asset: transparent 6 columns by 6 rows sprite animation atlas, exactly 36 separate complete full-body figures, equal cell size and generous transparent gutters, no text or lines. All 36 figures FACE FRONT toward viewer, game direction DOWN. Reference 1 original Cake Delivery idle: preserve outfit identity. Reference 2 chibi Pajama: use ONLY compact chibi proportions, head/body size ratio, soft game rendering and peach-pink hair volume, NOT its clothes. Reference 3 original Cake splash: outfit details only. Character Cherry: long loose flowing peach-pink hair, pastel pink front streak, warm brown eyes, long upright rabbit ears (never cat), loop ahoge, no tail. Cake-shop uniform: white off-shoulder blouse pink piping ruffled sleeves, rose-pink ribbon choker, white fitted apron pale-pink trim bunny pocket and tiny cherry charm, rose-pink back bow, dusty rose fitted TROUSERS, small closed white/pink flat SHOES (not slippers). NO props, food, cake, tray, box, effects, weapon or shadows. Consistent EXACT palette, scale, ear-top height and ground baseline across every cell. Body about 2.7 heads including ears like reference2. Six rows top to bottom: row1 IDLE breathing and one blink, feet stationary; row2 IDLE2 small happy smile then return; row3 WALK six evenly timed phases: LEFT contact, LEFT planted/right passing, RIGHT forward contact, RIGHT planted/left passing, LEFT forward contact, recovery smoothly looped. Walk is natural SHORT STEPS, knees and full lower legs alternate, shoes always point FRONT with a narrow hip-width stance, support foot flat heel and toe level, max lift tiny, no kicks/splits/tiptoes; row4 ATTACK six phases hands gather then extend forward one small magic-release gesture and return, feet planted; row5 WALK ATTACK same natural six-phase short walking cycle as row3 while hands make the small attack gesture, no legs twisting or backwards shoe, preserve same leg anatomy; row6 SKILL hands open outward for Pink Burst then recover, both feet planted. Clean whole figures, all hair/ear tips/fingers/shoe soles fully inside their own cells, opaque character interiors, genuinely transparent background. No glow, no separate floating specks. Walk and walk attack must keep precisely identical character design and colors to idle.

Use case: identity-preserve. Create a production game sprite atlas: EXACTLY 6 columns x 6 rows, 36 separate complete full-body Cherry figures on genuinely transparent background, regular cells, wide gutters, no grid or text. Reference1 is the CANONICAL finished Cake Delivery chibi: preserve its EXACT compact head/body proportions, peach pink hair and palette, warm brown eyes, loop ahoge, long rabbit ears, off-shoulder white ruffled blouse, rose neck ribbon, white apron pink piping/bunny pocket/cherry charm, fitted rose-pink long trousers, white/pink small flat closed SHOES. No slippers, no skirt instead of trousers, no tail, no hair ponytail. Reference2 older original Cake sprite is outfit/direction reference ONLY; shorten its body to reference1 chibi proportions. Hair stays long, thick, loose, identical curls. Exact same size, light, palette and ground baseline across all cells and actions. All shoes always face the same direction as the torso; ankles straight, support sole flat heel and forefoot on same plane. Natural SMALL alternating left/right walking, narrow hip width stance, no outward pointed or reversed foot, no kicks, no tiptoe or exaggerated high step. Six rows top to bottom: 1 idle breath and blink; 2 idle smile and return; 3 WALK one six-frame full alternating cycle: f1 left forward contact/right back; f2 left support/right low swing begins; f3 right passes forward; f4 right forward contact/left back; f5 right support/left low swing begins; f6 left passes forward then loops to f1. Whole knees/calves move, tiny shoe lift and short stride. Row4 standing ranged magic attack: gather hands, extend hands once, recover, feet planted. Row5 WALK ATTACK same short six-frame full walking cycle as row3 while hands perform small casting gesture; identical leg lengths/foot direction/stride to row3. Row6 area skill: open both arms outward then recover, feet planted. All poses have clean complete silhouette, ear tips, hair, fingers, shoe sole strictly within cells. Opaque character interiors, no props, food, cake, tray, boxes, weapons, ground shadows, magical glows, particles or floating elements.
DIRECTION REQUIREMENT: FRONT THREE QUARTER facing SCREEN DOWN-RIGHT (45 degrees), all36cells. Both eyes visible, right facing chest and shoes, hair behind toward upper-left.

up_right_alpha: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target is this existing 6x6 Cake Delivery Cherry rear-three-quarter game sprite atlas. REMOVE ONLY ALL WHITE/LIGHT GRAY BACKGROUND BETWEEN THE 36 FIGURES, output GENUINELY TRANSPARENT alpha=0 background. Character interiors must be fully opaque, preserve every original character RGB, exact 36-figure layout, dimensions, poses, palette and silhouette. Keep all white clothing, white shoe panels and tiny hair highlights inside the figures; those are not background. No new objects, no shadows, no glow, no relighting, no repainting, no rearrangement. The prior background is mistakenly partially opaque; replace it with complete real transparency. Preserve ear tips, fingers, hair curls and shoes. Output a clean reusable RGBA sprite atlas.
walk_v2: Original Idle frame-0 pixels, no new leg painting, RGB changes, leg thinning, shoe resizing or shoe rotation. Forward alternating two-leg mesh; rigid support sole.
